mapper.insert: INSERT INTO catalog_episode ( content_id, season, episode, title, air_date, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{episode.contentId}, #{episode.season}, #{episode.episode}, #{episode.title}, #{episode.airDate}, #{episode.createdAt}, #{episode.updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = COALESCE(VALUES(title), title), air_date = COALESCE(VALUES(air_date), air_date), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
